findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract immediately without cause and without paying you for your work, leaving you with no equivalent right or protection.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery before you have received full payment for it.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of updates prior to signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the agreement permits ending the contract without notice or payment, so I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers upon delivery before payment is complete, so I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable. Thank you for understanding. Best regards,
